title: 上海高考翻译背诵-68-25一模

items.zh: 北京烤鸭烤好时,香味让所有外国食客都垂涎三尺了。
items.en: By the time Beijing roast duck is done, its aroma makes all foreign diners’ mouth water.

items.zh: 无论你下月是否离职,做好手头的工作非常重要,这是你人品的体现.
items.en: Whether you resign or not, it is essential that you do your current work well, which is a reflection of your character.

items.zh: 这个被晨雾、悦耳的鸟鸣声和隐约的狗吠声包围的边陲小镇,慢慢地从酣睡中苏醒了。
items.en: Evveloped by the morning mist, melodious birdsong and distant barks, the border town was slowly awakening from deep sleep.

items.zh: 众所周知,远东各国的努力不仅保护了当地的环境,也为全球减少对这种危险元素的依赖做出了贡献。
items.en: It is well known that the efforts of Far East countries have not only protected the local environment, but also contributed to reducing reliance on this hazardous element globally.
